mapper.insert: insert into edu_library_document ( document_code, title, summary, file_name, file_ext, file_size, file_url, file_storage, cover_url, page_count, subject_id, school_stage, version_id, textbook_id, chapter_id, chapter_text, category_id, tag_names, visibility, allow_download, download_price, convert_status, preview_type, preview_url, preview_error, audit_status, recommend_flag, recommend_order, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{documentCode}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{fileName}, #{fileExt}, #{fileSize}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileStorage}, #{coverUrl}, #{pageCount}, #{subjectId}, #{schoolStage}, #{versionId}, #{textbookId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterText}, #{categoryId}, #{tagNames}, #{visibility}, #{allowDownload}, #{downloadPrice}, #{convertStatus}, #{previewType}, #{previewUrl}, #{previewError}, #{auditStatus}, #{recommendFlag}, #{recommendOrder}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{remark} )

title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, subject_id = #{subjectId}, school_stage = #{schoolStage}, version_id = #{versionId}, textbook_id = #{textbookId}, chapter_id = #{chapterId}, chapter_text = #{chapterText}, category_id = #{categoryId}, tag_names = #{tagNames}, visibility = #{visibility}, allow_download = #{allowDownload}, download_price = #{downloadPrice}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, page_count = #{pageCount}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, recommend_flag = #{recommendFlag}, recommend_order = #{recommendOrder}, status = #{status}, convert_status = #{convertStatus}, preview_type = #{previewType}, preview_url = #{previewUrl}, preview_error = #{previewError}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, remark = #{remark},
where document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'

update edu_library_document set download_count = coalesce(download_count, 0) + 1 where document_id = #{documentId}

mapper.select: select d.document_id, d.document_code, d.title, d.summary, d.file_name, d.file_ext, d.file_size, d.file_url, d.cover_url, d.page_count, d.subject_id, s.subject_name, d.school_stage, d.version_id, v.version_name, d.textbook_id, tb.textbook_name, d.chapter_id, d.chapter_text, d.category_id, c.category_name, d.tag_names, d.visibility, d.allow_download, d.view_count, d.favorite_count, d.preview_type, d.audit_status, d.recommend_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, rl.read_progress from edu_library_read_log rl inner join edu_library_document d on d.document_id = rl.document_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' left join edu_subject s on s.subject_id = d.subject_id left join edu_qb_textbook_version v on v.version_id = d.version_id left join edu_qb_textbook tb on tb.textbook_id = d.textbook_id left join edu_library_category c on c.category_id = d.category_id where rl.user_name = #{userName} order by rl.update_time desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_library_read_log (document_id, user_name, read_progress, update_time) values (#{documentId}, #{userName}, coalesce(#{readProgress}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) on conflict (document_id, user_name) do update set read_progress = coalesce(#{readProgress}, edu_library_read_log.read_progress), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from edu_library_document where del_flag = '0') as totalDocs, (select count(1) from edu_library_document where del_flag = '0' and audit_status = '0') as pendingAudit, (select count(1) from edu_library_document where del_flag = '0' and status = '1') as shelvedDocs, (select count(1) from edu_library_document where del_flag = '0' and convert_status = 'failed') as convertFailed, (select count(1) from edu_library_document where del_flag = '0' and convert_status = 'pending') as convertPending, (select count(1) from edu_library_category) as categoryCount
